global_style: High-contrast, cyberpunk-inspired presentation template featuring stark color blocks, magenta accents, diagonal stripe patterns, and glitch typography.

identity_anchors: High-contrast dark mode with vibrant magenta accent blocks
Vertically stacked, overlapping typographic 'glitch' effect for major headings
Thick diagonal stripe patterns used as framing elements and background anchors
Minimalist geometric cluster motif (triangle, square, circle)
Strict rectangular image masking breaking across split-color backgrounds

density_rules.low: Use one focal idea and generous whitespace.
density_rules.medium: Use two to six concise content groups on the observed grid.
density_rules.high: Remove decoration before reducing label size or hierarchy.

variation_rules: Vary image/text balance and emphasis while preserving anchors, grid, and color ratios.
anti_repetition_rules: Do not repeat the same primary composition or decoration placement on adjacent slides.
